desc: This publication is an STU update (version 2.1.0). It makes the periodOfLife extension available beyond Immunization, binds BodyStructure.morphology to the wider MorphologyEuVs value set, and allows an organization as the legal authenticator of a composition.
descmd: This publication is an STU update (version 2.1.0) of the HL7 Europe Base and Core FHIR IG
